jobs.description:
Are you ready to develop your career in trading and gain insights into the energy markets? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where you have impact from day one? At Alipes Capital, we offer the unique opportunity to work with highly skilled, innovative and fun colleagues while utilizing cutting edge technology.

We are seeking our next motivated Energy Analyst to join our growing energy trading desk.

About Alipes

We use machine learning technology for reading and interpreting fundamental and market data and execute our trading strategies based on this data. Since our inception in 2008, we have continuously grown and diversified into new business areas driven by our technology. Alipes aims to support liquid electricity markets and free flow of energy, which are crucial to facilitate the transition from fossil fuels to renewable energy sources, thereby promoting a sustainable future.

We are centrally located in Nordhavn, Copenhagen, and have 80 bright and ambitious team members.

About the Job

You will be a part of a dynamic team whose primary responsibility is to develop new strategies and ensure that all algorithms and systems run smoothly on a daily basis. This means handling the full algorithm life-cycle from inception, through calibration, backtesting, live-implementation, validation and post-release monitoring and optimisation.

At Alipes, we offer a steep learning curve with responsibility and ownership from day one. You will have the responsibility for reviewing positions and overall exposure, as well as adjusting if applicable - this also includes shared on-call responsibility within the team for the occasional calls that come in outside of business hours. We take pride in maintaining a healthy risk reward trade-off by maximizing revenue under exposure and regulatory constraints. In addition, you will collaborate closely with our Tech and Quant teams.

About You

• 
You have a Masters in Economics, Finance, Mathematics or related field, or a Bachelors with some relevant professional experience.

• 
Experience working with Python. Experience with SQL is a plus.

• 
Experience with energy or trading in financial markets.

• 
Structured, analytical and enjoy analyzing large data sets and working with numbers

• 
Able to thrive and stay calm in a high pressure environment

• 
Conscientious with an eye for detail, even when tasks become routine

• 
You take initiative and ownership in your work.

• 
You don't mind occasionally working outside the standard office hours

What We can Offer You

• 
Competitive benefits, including pension, health insurance, and 30 days of vacation.

• 
A modern office in Copenhagen (Nordhavn).

• 
A flat hierarchy with high levels of trust, autonomy, and freedom to make decisions.

• 
A valued role with unique responsibilities and plenty of room for creativity.

• 
Fast feedback and recognition of your contributions in a high-growth company.

• 
Strong team spirit - successes are celebrated with company events and trips.

Join Alipes

To apply, please send us your CV as well as a copy of your university transcripts/grades via the application link. You are welcome to contact us with questions at Energy_jobs@alipescapital.com.

Please do not send your application to the email address as our hiring team will not have visibility. We look forward to hearing from you!

Company Description

At Coach Solutions, we build software that helps the global shipping industry work smarter and make data-driven decisions — for both profit and sustainability. Backed by Kongsberg Maritime, we're entering a new phase: modernizing our architecture and scaling our impact.

Job Description

We're looking for a Senior Frontend / Full-Stack Developer to join our Platform & Development department. You'll take ownership of frontend development across our SaaS products, working closely with developers, QA, Product, and other stakeholders to deliver reliable, scalable software used by customers across the shipping industry.

Our stack centres on Next.js, React, Typescript and Vercel, backed by Azure and .NET Standard services, with Mapbox and tilesets powering our geospatial visualizations. We're an AI-fluent team — you'll be expected to use AI-assisted tools as part of how you work, not just be curious about them.

Qualifications

What you'll do

• Design, build, and maintain modern frontend applications with React and Next.js.

• Build interactive maps and geospatial visualizations using Mapbox and tilesets.

• Integrate frontend applications with backend REST APIs, including .NET Standard services — with room to grow into full-stack work overtime.

• Contribute to modernizing our existing architecture, with an eye on maintainability, scalability, and security.

• Own features end-to-end: from design and implementation through testing, deployment, and monitoring (via tools like Monitive).

• Use GitHub and GitHub Actions for version control, code review, and CI/CD.

• Use AI-assisted development tools day-to-day to improve code quality, testing, and delivery speed.

• Share knowledge, raise technical risks early, and help shape how the team works.

What you bring

Must have

• 5+ years of professional software development experience, with a strong focus on frontend and production software used by real customers.

• Strong hands-on experience with React, Next.js, and TypeScript/JavaScript.

• Solid grasp of frontend architecture: component design, state management, responsive UIs.

• Experience integrating frontend apps with REST APIs and backend services.

• Comfortable with Git/GitHub, code review, and CI/CD pipelines.

• Genuinely AI-fluent: you already use AI coding tools and understand their limits, not just open to trying them.

• Clear communicator — able to explain technical trade-offs to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to have (we'll teach the rest)

• Experience with Mapbox, tilesets, or geospatial data — no prior background required if you're keen to learn.

• Exposure to Vercel deployment workflows.

• Comfort working in Azure-based environments.

• .NET Standard experience, or interest in growing into full-stack work.

• Familiarity with monitoring/observability tools such as Monitive.

Additional Information

Practical details

• Location: Copenhagen, on-site with hybrid flexibility

• Team: Platform & Development department

Why Coach Solutions

• A purpose-driven workplace at the intersection of tech and sustainability.

• Real influence: if you see the problem, you own it — and if you make the best argument, you win, regardless of title.

• An informal, social culture — monthly Friday bars, team events, summer and winter parties, family events, and more.

• A skilled mentor and an experienced, engineering-minded team eager to help you succeed.

• Room to grow — new responsibilities and career paths as the company scales.

Don't check every box?

That's okay — we'd still love to hear from you. If you have strong frontend experience, a passion for building great software, and the motivation to learn and grow, reach out. Let's build something meaningful together.

Help grow Awaze’s commercial footprint across Germany, Austria and Switzerland by building high-performing travel agency relationships and strategic partnerships that bring our holidays to even more guests.

Your mission

As our new Senior Partnership Account Manager, your mission is to grow Awaze’s commercial footprint across the DACH region through two interconnected areas: developing our travel agency channel and building strategic commercial partnerships.

As you’ll be working directly with travel agencies and partners across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, you’ll need to be fluent in German, at native or near-native level, as well as confident communicating professionally in English.

You’ll own and grow relationships with travel agencies across the region, lead agencies through the transition from legacy booking systems to Awaze’s modern platform, and identify new opportunities to expand our network. Alongside this, you’ll develop strategic partnerships from initial prospecting and negotiation through to onboarding and ongoing account development.

Working closely with Marketing, Product, Commercial and leadership teams, you’ll use market insight and performance data to strengthen partner engagement, extend Awaze’s reach and deliver measurable commercial impact.

What you'll be doing

• 
Own and develop relationships with travel agencies across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, with a particular focus on chains and networks.

• 
Lead the end-to-end transition of agencies from legacy booking systems to Awaze’s modern platform, including change management, training and onboarding.

• 
Identify, develop and onboard new travel agency partners, maintaining a strong pipeline of prospective agencies.

• 
Proactively identify, pursue, negotiate and close new strategic commercial partnerships across the DACH region.

• 
Manage the full partnership lifecycle, from initial outreach and commercial negotiation through to onboarding and ongoing account development.

• 
Monitor agency and partnership performance, using data and commercial metrics to identify opportunities for increased adoption, engagement and growth.

• 
Collaborate with Marketing, Product and Commercial teams to ensure partners are effectively supported and positioned for success.

• 
Identify co-marketing and co-branding opportunities that create mutual value and extend Awaze’s reach and brand presence.

• 
Act as a source of DACH market intelligence, sharing relevant trends, partner feedback and commercial insights with leadership and product teams.

• 
Travel regularly across the DACH region to build and strengthen relationships with agencies and strategic partners.

Who we’re looking for

You’ll thrive in this role if you’re a natural relationship builder who enjoys turning commercial opportunities into long-term, mutually valuable partnerships. You’re comfortable taking ownership of a varied portfolio, confident working independently and equally at home discussing performance data, negotiating a new partnership or helping an established agency embrace a new way of working.

Fluent German, at native or near-native level, is an essential requirement for this role. You’ll use German regularly to build trusted relationships and communicate effectively with travel agencies and strategic partners across the DACH region.

We’re looking for someone who brings:

• 
Several years of experience in account management, partnerships or business development, ideally within travel, hospitality or a related sector.

• 
A demonstrable track record of growing accounts and closing partnerships that deliver measurable commercial outcomes.

• 
Fluent German, at native or near-native level, alongside strong professional English, both written and spoken.

• 
Strong relationship-building, communication and presentation skills, with the credibility to engage agency owners, commercial partners and senior stakeholders.

• 
Strong analytical capabilities and confidence using performance data and commercial metrics to inform decisions and identify opportunities.

• 
An understanding of brand and marketing principles and the ability to represent Awaze consistently with external partners.

• 
A self-motivated and structured approach, with the ability to independently manage a large and varied account portfolio.

• 
Willingness and ability to travel regularly across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, as well as other locations when required.

• 
Bonus points if you have experience within the DACH travel agency landscape, legacy travel booking systems or digital platform transitions, or have worked within or alongside a major European travel group.

• 
An established network across DACH travel agencies or hospitality chains, or experience with GDS tools and partnership management platforms, would also be an advantage.

How you'll make an impact

• 
Successfully transition and onboard travel agencies onto Awaze’s modern platform, driving strong adoption and engagement.

• 
Grow the number, quality and performance of active travel agency relationships across the DACH region.

• 
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of prospective agencies and strategic partners, progressing opportunities through to successful commercial agreements.

• 
Strengthen retention, satisfaction and commercial performance across your agency and partnership portfolio.

• 
Turn performance data into clear insights and recommendations that help both our partners and internal teams make better commercial decisions.

• 
Work across Marketing, Product and Commercial teams to unlock partner support, co-marketing opportunities and additional commercial value.

• 
Bring relevant DACH market trends, partner feedback and insights into Awaze to help inform product and business decisions.

• 
Champion Awaze’s brands and standards across every agency and partner interaction.

Why you’ll want to work at Awaze

We offer a versatile position in a strong professional and social environment - one you’ll have the opportunity to influence and help shape. You’ll be part of an international company that invests in the future, and join a dynamic, fast-paced department with skilled and committed colleagues who support each other.

We’re a people-first business - and we know that our success starts with our teams. Here’s a glimpse of what you’ll enjoy:

• 
Generous discounts on holidays across our brands

• 
Flexible hybrid working – with the autonomy to work how you work best

• 
Real opportunities to grow, learn and shape your role as well as careers progression vertically or horizontally, cross countries and responsibilities.

About Awaze

Our mission is clear - to create amazing holidays with Europe’s widest choice of holiday homes.

With more than 110,000 properties across Europe, we are the largest managed vacation rentals business in the region. Our ambition is not only to be the biggest, but the best provider of holiday homes in Europe.

As travel continues to evolve, we are focused on what comes next. We will keep strengthening our relationships with guests and homeowners, continuously improving the way we work, and delivering strong performance. By making things simpler and smarter, we are building a business that is ready for what’s next - powered by proud, passionate and inclusive people.

Worth knowing

• 
This role can be based remotely in Germany or from our Virum office in Denmark.

• 
Regular travel across Germany, Austria and Switzerland will be an important part of the role, with travel to other locations when required.

What’s next?

If this sounds like the right next step for you, hit “Apply” and follow the instructions to submit your application. We tailor our recruitment process to each role to give both you and our hiring teams the best possible chance to assess whether this could be the start of a successful collaboration. You’ll hear from us shortly after we’ve reviewed your application.

We’re committed to running an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment, and if you have any specific requirements or adjustments needed for the interview, just let us know when you accept your invitation - we’re happy to accommodate.

Own information security governance, risk and compliance at a growing Danish fintech. As our Information Security & Compliance Manager, you’ll lead audit and assurance work, turn security requirements into controls that teams can use in their day-to-day work, and help management decide which risks and improvements to prioritise.

About Loyalty Key

Loyalty Key is a fast-growing Danish fintech company that develops and operates digital loyalty solutions. Our own card-linked technology makes it possible to earn cashback with any payment card.

Through Visa Cashback and Danske Bank Cashback, we connect more than 500,000 members with over 2,000 partner retailers.

We also operate significant parts of the SAS EuroBonus programme, including its Nordic online shopping platform, where members earn points when they shop online.

About the role

You’ll take ownership of our information security and compliance framework, maintain our existing assurance programme and help prepare the business for future certifications. You’ll work closely with management, IT and teams across the business. You’ll lead governance, risk and compliance, while our IT team will be responsible for implementing technical security measures.In this role, you’ll:

• 
Maintain and develop our security and compliance framework, including policies, procedures and controls.

• 
Coordinate audits and assurance activities, organise evidence and follow up on findings until they’re resolved.

• 
Carry out risk assessments, monitor how well controls work and report key risks and priorities to management.

• 
Work with IT and other teams to put security requirements into practice and make responsibilities clear.

• 
Support supplier security assessments and respond to customer requests about security and compliance.

What you bring

You have experience in information security, compliance, IT risk or audit, and you’ve worked with security controls, audits or assurance frameworks. You understand the technology behind the controls and can explain what a requirement means in practice to technical and non-technical colleagues.

You’re organised, pragmatic and comfortable working independently. You document decisions clearly, take initiative and follow through on agreed actions.

Experience with ISAE 3402, SOC 2, ISO 27001 or similar standards and frameworks is an advantage, as is experience in fintech, payments, SaaS or financial services. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every qualification. You must have the right to live and work in Denmark.

Why work at Loyalty Key

• 
Join a team of 45 with an informal culture, short decision-making paths and room to take ownership.

• 
Shape how we manage information security, risk and compliance as the company grows, with direct access to management and close collaboration across teams.

• 
Develop professionally and personally through a varied role with broad responsibility.

• 
Receive a salary based on your qualifications, health insurance and other employee benefits.

• 
Get to know your colleagues through social events, Friday bars and shared celebrations.

Start date and location

The start date is by agreement. Our Copenhagen office is at Dampfærgevej 21, 2100 Copenhagen Ø, between Østerport and Nordhavn stations.

Questions and applications

For more information about the role, contact Aaron Morley at aam@loyaltykey.com.**

We interview on a rolling basis, so please apply as soon as possible with your CV, a short cover letter explaining why the role interests you, and any other relevant documents.**

jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Civil and Architectural Engineering programme. The position is available from 1 February 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title:
AI-augmented Physiological Modelling for Prediction and Mitigation of Heat Stress in Pigs

Research area and project description:
Heat stress is an increasing challenge to pig production and animal welfare, particularly during hot seasons. Effective mitigation requires not only the detection of elevated heat load, but also the ability to predict how animals respond dynamically and to determine when and how cooling interventions should be applied. Existing mechanistic thermal models provide an important basis for representing animal heat balance and physiological responses. However, their ability to incorporate real-time physiological observations, account for model assumptions and environmental stochasticity, and support timely intervention decisions remains limited. At the same time, purely data-driven black-box approaches are challenging to develop and validate when high-quality physiological datasets are limited, as is often the case in controlled animal experiments.

This PhD project aims to develop a physics-informed digital model for predicting and mitigating heat stress in pigs. Building on conventional mechanistic models of pig physiological responses, the project will investigate how physiological modelling can be combined with AI approaches to develop a more robust and interpretable representation of the pig’s thermal state. To further enhance the accessibility and practical use of the model, the project will also explore how large language models (LLMs) can be integrated with the physiological model to facilitate interactive exploration of model behaviour and predictions.

Qualifications and specific competences:
We are looking for a highly motivated candidate with:
• A MSc degree in Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, or Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or related filed.
• A strong academic background and interest in HVAC systems in buildings, and fluid and thermal systems modelling.
• Proven experience in data analytics, machine learning, and optimisation.
• Ability to program using Python, R, MATLAB or similar platforms.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in interdisciplinary teams.
• Excellent written and spoken English skills.It is considered an advantage if you have:
• Knowledge of animal heat stress and animal welfare.
• Knowledge of Large Language Model, stochastic modelling, system identification.
• Experience with CFD simulations.
Place of employment and place of work:
The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is Department of Civil and Architectural Engineering, Inge Lehmanns Gade 10, 8000 Aarhus C., Denmark.

Contacts:
Applicants seeking further information regarding the PhD position are invited to contact:
• Associate Professor Li Rong, e-mail: li.rong@cae.au.dk (main supervisor)
• Assistant Professor Tao Huang, e-mail: taoh@cae.au.dk (co-supervisor)For information about application requirements and mandatory attachments, please see our application guide. If answers cannot be found there, please contact:
• admission.gradschool.tech@au.dk

Please make a project description (½-4 pages). The project description should describe your ideas and research plans for this specific project. If you wish to, you can indicate an URL where further information can be found.

Formalities and salary range
Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions. You will be employed as an academic staff member at basic salary grades 4–8. As a PhD fellow you will also receive a monthly non-pensionable allowance.

proprty.ai is building a service to help Danish property managers leverage machine learning technology to create better condition assessments and maintenance plans. The cost of maintaining the Danish property mass is growing fast, and property managers are struggling to keep up with maintenance and regulatory responsibilities. This is not only hurting the property managers, but also the people using and living in the buildings. The challenge to live up to the EU Taxonomy for Sustainable Activities, is made harder, by not having the tools nor data to make the right strategic choices when planning and executing maintenance. With our service we aim to create property condition assessment and maintenance plans faster and more accurately than what is possible today. Using machine learning algorithms trained on millions of m2 worth of data, we can provide property managers with data to make the right decisions, when it comes to spending resources on maintenance. That way they can cut costs, improve property conditions and push the property mass towards a sustainable future. We're creating an AI powered web platform, that allows property managers to create condition assessments and maintenance plans in a fraction of the time they're using today, by mixing output from our machine learning models with boots on the ground input. It's not only faster. It provides high quality data instead of subjective information. At proprty.ai we've already signed partnerships with 18% of the Danish residential property market. We have a very real problem to solve, and a strong team to do it.

jobs.occupation: PhD scholarship in High-Speed Hyperspectral and Super-Resolution Terahertz Imaging - DTU Electro
jobs.description:
Are you interested in pushing terahertz (THz) imaging beyond today’s limits in speed, bandwidth, and spatial resolution? 

At DTU Electro, you will work at the interface of ultrafast THz photonics, nonlinear optical detection, coherent imaging, and machine learning to develop a new generation of high-speed hyperspectral THz imaging technology.

The PhD project is part of the DFF-funded INSPIRING project (High-speed hyperspectral and super-resolution terahertz imaging). INSPIRING will combine broadband THz-to-near-infrared upconversion with CMOS-array detection to enable high-speed THz imaging. Your main role will be to establish the imaging platform and develop hyperspectral and machine-learning methods for super-resolution imaging and material identification.

You will work in an international, interdisciplinary team at DTU Electro. The project includes a planned 3–6-month research stay in Prof. Xi-Cheng Zhang’s group at the University of Rochester, USA.

Responsibilities and qualifications
Your research will focus on high-speed coherent THz imaging with machine learning. 

You will:

• Develop and operate a broadband coherent THz imaging platform using optical rectification and/or laser-induced plasma THz sources.
• Implement wide-field imaging based on THz-to-NIR upconversion and CMOS focal-plane-array detection.
• Acquire and analyze time-domain hyperspectral THz data with a target bandwidth above 10 THz.
• Apply machine-learning methods, including CNN and autoencoder-type architectures, for super-resolution reconstruction and material identification.
• Study semiconductors, polymers, multilayer structures, and industrial test samples, and collaborate with project partners in Denmark and abroad. 
• Publish your results in peer-reviewed journals and present them at international conferences.
We are looking for a highly motivated and curious candidate with a strong background in experimental photonics, optics, applied physics, electrical engineering, or a closely related field. Experience with THz spectroscopy, ultrafast laser systems, nonlinear optics, or optical imaging is highly desirable. Experience with scientific programming, data analysis, image processing, or machine learning will be considered an advantage. You should have a strong interest in experimental research and be comfortable working with complex optical setups as well as analyzing large multidimensional datasets. We value creativity, independent problem-solving, and the ability to work effectively in an interdisciplinary and international research environment. You should also have good communication skills and be able to present and communicate your scientific results clearly in written and spoken English.

You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

Assessment
The assessment of the applicants will be made by Associate Professor Binbin Zhou, Professor Peter Uhd Jepsen, and Associate Professor Francesco Da Ros. 

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures. 

The period of employment is 3 years. The start date is 1 January 2027 (or by mutual agreement). The position is a full-time position.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information
Further information may be obtained from Associate Professor Binbin Zhou at zhou@dtu.dk. 

You can read more about DTU Electro at www.electro.dtu.dk. 

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. 

Application procedure 
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 30 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. 

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Electro  
DTU Electro employs more than 300 skilled researchers with competencies in electrical and photonics engineering. As a department, we strive towards creating sustainable energy and a greener internet, as well as strengthening cyber security and health technology. Working with industry and public organizations is one of our top priorities to find and implement new solutions to our society. We aim to offer education, research, and innovation of the highest standard, and our focus on application-oriented research enables us to work across many engineering disciplines and research areas, such as IT and the medical and health sciences. We have a close collaboration with researchers from all over the world, just as we collaborate with industry and public authorities about the dissemination of solutions based on electrical and photonics engineering as their key enabling technologies. 

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

Would you like to help build and develop the platform that makes it easier for Whiteaway’s software Engineers to develop, deploy and run their solutions?

Whiteaway Group is looking for a skilled Platform Engineer to join their Platform Squad in Aarhus.

As a Platform Engineer, you will become part of a strong technical environment focused on building and continuously improving the platform used by Whiteaway’s development teams in their daily work.

This is not traditional IT operations. Instead, the focus is on creating automated, stable and scalable solutions that make it easier for Engineers to develop, deploy and run their software.

Whiteaway is a digital-first company where technology plays a central role in the business. The company operates some of the largest online stores in the Nordics within electronics and home appliances, and its technical platforms are an important part of the continued development of the business.

Your role

You will play a central role in developing and improving Whiteaway’sinternal platform and will work closely with software Engineers and the other members of the Platform Squad.

A key part of the role is the close collaboration with Engineers. You will be curious about how they work, understand their needs and challenges, and use their feedback to identify how workflows, processes and platform tooling can be made simpler, faster and better.

Over the coming years, Whiteaway will be taking the platform to a significantly higher level. A key focus will be reducing and removing legacy and building a more modern, scalable and developer-friendly platform. AI will also play an increasingly important role in how the platform develops and how Whiteaway’s Engineers work.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Developing and continuously improving the cloud platform

• Automating deployment and development processes

• Infrastructure as Code

• CI/CD pipelines

• Containerisation and Kubernetes

• Cloud infrastructure – primarily AWS

• Monitoring, observability and reliability

• Engineering tooling and self-service solutions

• Security and access management

• Troubleshooting and optimising platform performance and stability

The role offers a high degree of freedom, and you will have the opportunity to take ownership and influence both the technology and the way the team works.

Whiteaway believes in freedom under responsibility. You will have the opportunity to take ownership, influence technical decisions and help shape both the platform and the way the team works.

We imagine that you…

You have a strong technical background and experience within software development, cloud, DevOps or platform engineering. Perhaps you are already working as a Platform Engineer, Cloud Engineer, DevOps Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer or Senior Software Engineer with strong cloud and infrastructure experience.

Your title is less important than your motivation to work hands-on with platform engineering and your ability to thrive at the intersection of software development, cloud and operations. Experience with general software development is an advantage, particularly Node.js and/or Go.

We would like you to have experience with several of the following technologies and tools:

• AWS

• Kubernetes

• Docker

• Terraform / Infrastructure as Code

• CI/CD

• Git/GitHub

• Linux

• Node.js and/or Go

• Datadog

• ArgoCD

• Spacelift

• Cloudflare

• Monitoring and observability

• Networking and cloud infrastructure

Experience with GitOps is an advantage, but not a requirement. Experience with security or with the intersection between operations and software development is also considered an advantage.

You do not need to know everything. What matters most is that you have strong technical curiosity, can understand complex problems and are motivated to continuously improve the way things are done.

Your professional development is important to Whiteaway.

You will have the opportunity to work with development plans, strengthen your technical skills and take your expertise to the next level. At the same time, knowledge sharing is an important part of the culture – you are expected not only to develop yourself, but also to help lift others around you.

On a personal level, drive, determination and humility are highly valued. You take ownership and get things done, while remaining curious, collaborative and motivated to find the best solutions together with others.

What Whiteaway offers

At Whiteaway, you will be part of an informal, inclusive and supportive leadership culture where Engineers have real ownership and the opportunity to influence their work. The culture is built around experimentation, knowledge sharing and continuous learning, with opportunities to take part in hackathons, pair programming and MOB programming, as well as access to learning resources.

The social side of working together is also important. People at Whiteaway genuinely enjoy working together, and there is a strong focus on building good relationships across the team. Through activities such as hackathons, Improvement Mondays and other social initiatives, there are plenty of opportunities to come together, share knowledge, experiment and have fun.

Whiteaway also values a healthy work-life balance, a great lunch and good colleagues. The office is located in Skejby, with free parking.

About Whiteaway Group

Whiteaway Group is a tribe of 300+ passionate people working across Scandinavia, selling and shipping appliances through e-commerce, franchise stores and B2B channels.

Around 250 employees are based at the headquarters in Aarhus, covering the group’s central functions. Around 45 people work within Tech across IT, Engineering and Product. The Platform Squad currently consists of four Platform Engineers, and the team is expected to grow in the coming years as the demands on and use of the platform continue to increase – including with the growing use of AI.

With brands like Skousen, Tretti and Whiteaway, the group is grounded in innovation and honesty, always pushing for better customer experiences through technology.

The Opportunity

Join Veo as an Android Engineer and play a key role in taking our mobile app to the next level. Based in Copenhagen, you’ll collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers to craft exceptional user experiences that connect seamlessly with our hardware and platform ecosystem.

This is an opportunity to shape the future of a product that’s transforming how sports are captured, watched, and shared - all within a fast-moving, collaborative, and purpose-driven environment.

At Veo, you’ll join a team of skilled, motivated people who care deeply about what they build and about each other.

Write high-quality, maintainable Kotlin code to deliver incremental product features.

Collaborate closely with product, design, and backend teams to shape technical requirements and solutions.

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in our expansion across Europe, designing, implementing, and maintaining the cloud infrastructure that powers our growth. You'll work closely with our development teams to streamline deployment processes, elevate our CI/CD pipelines, and ensure our systems remain secure, reliable, and scalable as we expand into new markets. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to shape infrastructure decisions at a company scaling fast across multiple regions.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Design, implement, and manage scalable infrastructure on AWS

• 
Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions to automate build, test, and deployment processes

• 
Collaborate with development teams to integrate DevOps practices throughout the software development lifecycle

• 
Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform to automate infrastructure provisioning and management

• 
Monitor system performance and health using New Relic, ensuring high availability and reliability

• 
Implement security best practices and ensure compliance with industry standards (including PCI DSS where applicable)

• 
Design and support infrastructure across multiple regions, with an eye toward resilience, redundancy, and data residency requirements

• 
Participate in a rolling on-call rotation, providing 24/7 support and ensuring critical issues are resolved quickly and efficiently

• 
Mentor junior team members and champion DevOps best practices across the team

Your skills & experience

What we are looking for:

• 
3+ years of experience as a Senior DevOps Engineer or equivalent

• 
Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform on AWS

• 
Strong background in AWS, including ECS, RDS, VPC, and ideally IoT Core

• 
Proficiency with CI/CD tools, specifically GitHub

• 
Experience with monitoring/observability tools such as New Relic

• 
Hands-on experience with Docker and containerized environments

• 
Solid understanding of networking, security, and system architecture

• 
Excellent problem-solving skills and strong attention to detail

• 
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across team
